news.summary: Washington borrows over a trillion dollars a year just to pay interest on what it already owes, and two of Wall Street's most powerful executives are warning the pressure on bond markets has not yet reached its peak.
news.title_zh: 政府每天支出比收入多約 $5.5 Billion。債務在 10 年內翻倍。Jaime Dimon 認為情況可能會惡化得更嚴重。
news.summary_zh: 華盛頓每年借入超過一兆美元僅為支付現有債務利息，華爾街兩大權勢人物警告債券市場壓力尚未達到頂峰。

news.title: Bessent Tells the Fed Not to Hike “Too Much”
news.summary: Treasury wants the Fed to ease off while the officials who actually vote on rates lean the other way. Long-bond holders sit in the middle of that standoff, and two December dates could decide who wins.
news.title_zh: Bessent 告訴聯準會不要加息「太多」
news.summary_zh: 財政部希望聯準會緩手，而實際投票決定利率的官員則傾向相反方向。長期債券持有者處於這場對峙的中間，而十二月的兩個日期可能決定誰獲勝。

news.title: Kevin Warsh’s Fed Will Vote on Rates Only 7 Times in 2027
news.summary: The Fed is quietly trimming its meeting calendar, and long-term Treasuries already flinched. With a hike looming in December, fewer decision days could make every surprise hit bond holders harder. Which corner of the bond market gets hurt most?
news.title_zh: Kevin Warsh 的聯準會將僅在 2027 對利率投票 7 Times 次
news.summary_zh: 聯準會正悄悄縮減其會議行程，長期公債已有所反應。隨著十二月即將加息，較少的決策日可能使每個驚喜對債券持有者的衝擊更大。債券市場的哪個角落受損最重？

news.title: The U.S. Just Ran Its Biggest October Deficit Ever: $404 Billion
news.summary: A record October gap has a calendar quirk hiding the real story, and bond investors are already reacting. Why do long-dated Treasury funds feel the pain first, and what would prove the bearish case wrong by December?
news.title_zh: 美國剛錄得有史以來最大的十月赤字：$404 Billion
news.summary_zh: 創紀錄的十月缺口因行曆怪癖而掩蓋了真實故事，債券投資者已有反應。為何長期公債基金首當其衝感受痛苦，到十二月什麼情況能證明看空論點錯誤？

news.title: How Large Does Your Portfolio Need to Be to Generate $9,400 a Month?
news.summary: Six income holdings, one monthly paycheck target, and a stretch of the portfolio that could vanish in a merger. See which pick carries the shakiest check and which one quietly raises its payout every year.
news.title_zh: 您的投資組合需要多大才能每月產生 $9,400？
news.summary_zh: 六檔收益型持倉、一個月度薪資目標，以及一段可能因合併而消失的投資組合部分。看看哪一檔的支票最不穩固，哪一檔每年悄悄增加派息。

news.title: The Treasury Secretary Is Now Living on a Military Base After Iranian Threats
news.summary: Markets barely flinched when news broke that a cabinet secretary had moved onto a military base. Yet the quiet in oil and long bonds may hide a bigger risk for anyone holding USO or TLT, and a few scheduled events could expose it.
news.title_zh: 財政部長在伊朗威脅後現居住於軍事基地
news.summary_zh: 當內閣部長遷入軍事基地的消息傳出時，市場幾乎未受驚動。然而，原油與長期債券的平靜可能掩蓋著持有 USO 或 TLT 者的更大風險，且幾項既定事件可能揭露該風險。

news.summary: One fund lends to companies and pays more. The other lends to the U.S. government and offers more safety. Here is how to choose.

news.title_zh: 哪檔長期債券 ETF 較值得買入：State Street 的 SPLB 還是 iShares 的 TLT？
news.summary_zh: 一檔基金借款給企業並支付較高利息；另一檔則借款給美國政府，提供較高安全性。以下說明如何選擇。

news.title: The 2-Year Treasury Yield Just Had Its Biggest Jump in 19 Months
news.summary: A hawkish Fed governor and a stubborn inflation print hit bond markets on the same day, and two Treasury ETFs reacted in very different ways. Which one is better placed for the rate shock, and what could flip that view?
news.title_zh: 第 2 年期公債殖利率剛出現 19 個月來最大漲幅
news.summary_zh: 一位鷹派美聯儲理事和頑固的通脹數據同一天衝擊債券市場，兩檔公債 ETF 的反應截然不同。哪一檔更適合應對利率衝擊，什麼因素可能扭轉這一觀點？

news.summary: The yield premium on the U.S. 10-year Treasury note surged to its widest level in more than two years in October as investors demanded greater compensation for inflation and fiscal risks.
news.title: Inflation Fears Push Treasury Yields Further Above Fair Value
news.title_zh: 通膨恐慌推高國債殖利率進一步偏離合理價值
news.summary_zh: 美國 10 年期國庫券的殖利率溢價在十月飆升至逾兩年來最高水平，因投資人要求更高補償以應對通膨和財政風險。

news.title: Foreign-Linked Buyers Took Their Smallest Share of a 3-Year Treasury Auction in 15 Months
news.summary: A Treasury auction drew unusually weak demand from the buyers who usually signal overseas appetite, yet dealers were left holding almost nothing. Three dates this week will show whether that mixed picture is a warning for bond fund holders or just noise.
news.title_zh: 外資買家在 3 年期公債拍賣中佔比創 15 個月新低
news.summary_zh: 一場公債拍賣吸引了通常代表海外胃口的買家異常疲軟的需求，但交易商幾乎未被留下持倉。本週三個日期將顯示這種好壞參半的圖像是否為債券基金持有者的警訊，還只是雜訊。

news.title: Odds of a December Rate Hike Jump to 77% After a Blowout Jobs Report
news.summary: Stocks shrugged, Treasuries barely twitched, and yet the two-year yield told a different story. One hot jobs print has Fed watchers rethinking December, and the next CPI release could decide whether SPY holds its ground.
news.title_zh: 十二月加息機率升至 77%，因強勁就業報告
news.summary_zh: 股市反應平淡，美債幾無波動，但兩年期殖利率卻傳達不同訊號。一份火熱的就業數據讓聯準會觀察者重新評估十二月，下一份 CPI 數據可能決定 SPY 能否守住陣腳。

news.title: Microsoft Nears $500 Million Deal to Sell AI to ByteDance, Irking OpenAI
news.summary: ByteDance is in advanced talks to spend an additional roughly $500 million on cloud services from Microsoft, primarily to use OpenAI models from Microsoft’s Azure cloud, according to two people with knowledge of the situation. The move to expand the Chinese firm’s already large contract with Microsoft has drawn the ire of OpenAI. The AI company has complained to Microsoft in recent months that it believes Chinese firms are “distilling” its AI, or running OpenAI models to create their own competing AI models, according to the people with knowledge of the discussions. OpenAI itself prevents most Chinese firms from using its AI, but Microsoft—which has the rights to sell OpenAI’s technology—doesn’t impose the same restrictions.
news.title_zh: Microsoft 近乎 $500 Million 交易向 ByteDance 出售 AI，惹惱 OpenAI
news.summary_zh: 據兩位知情人士透露，ByteDance 正處於進階談判階段，擬額外花費約 $500 million 採購 Microsoft 的雲端服務，主要為使用 Microsoft Azure 雲端上的 OpenAI 模型。此舉擴大該中國公司與 Microsoft 已有的龐大合約，引發 OpenAI 憤慨。據知情人士稱，OpenAI 近月向 Microsoft 投訴，認為中國企業正在「蒸餾」其 AI，即運用 OpenAI 模型開發自家競爭性 AI 模型。OpenAI 本身禁止大多數中國企業使用其 AI，但擁有銷售 OpenAI 技術權利的 Microsoft 卻未施加相同限制。

news.title: Insider Buying: EuroDry (NASDAQ:EDRY) Director Acquires 1,150 Shares of Stock
news.summary: EuroDry (NASDAQ:EDRY - Get Free Report) Director Aristeidis Pittas acquired 1,150 shares of the company's stock in a transaction dated Monday, November 16th. The stock was purchased at an average cost of $37.45 per share, with a total value of $43,067.50. Following the completion of the purchase, the director directly owned 77,663 shares of the company's stock, valued at approximately $2,908,479.35. This represents a 1.50% increase in their position. The acquisition was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through the SEC website.

news.summary: Yes, but only if you bought AMD after late May. A share bought at the start of 2026 is up 135.1%. That is a gain, not a loss. AMD closed at $503.41 on Tuesday, Nov 17. It closed above that price on 81 of the 221 trading days of 2026. All of those days fell between May 26 and Nov 16. Only a share bought at one of those closes shows a loss now.

news.title: Meta Platforms (NASDAQ:META) Stock: Insider Javier Olivan Sells 939 Shares
news.summary: Meta Platforms, Inc. (NASDAQ:META - Get Free Report) COO Javier Olivan sold 939 shares of the company's stock in a transaction that occurred on Monday, November 16th. The stock was sold at an average price of $640.39, for a total transaction of $601,326.21. Following the completion of the transaction, the chief operating officer owned 10,853 shares in the company, valued at approximately $6,950,152.67. This trade represents a 7.96% decrease in their ownership of the stock. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through the SEC website. The transaction was executed under a pre-arranged Rule 10b5-1 trading plan. The sale was made to cover tax withholding obligations related to the vesting of equity awards.

news.title: NuScale Sinks 22% in a Week to a 52-Week Low as Canada’s First SMR Runs Late. Is the Selling Overdone?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysNuScale fell 22% in a week to a 52-week low after Canada’s first GE Vernova Hitachi small modular reactor ran late and over budget. Oklo fell too, but NuScale, still without a binding module order, fell about twice as much.

news.title: Meta’s Prepayment Is Buying Oklo’s Nuclear Fuel for Up to Five Reactors
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo (OKLO) signed definitive agreements with Centrus Energy (LEU) on November 12 to secure enough nuclear fuel for up to five Aurora powerhouses, with deliveries starting in 2029. Meta Platforms (META) is helping finance fuel purchases for Oklo’s planned 1.
news.title_zh: Meta 的預付款正在為 Oklo 的最多五座反應堆購買核燃料
news.summary_zh: 關鍵要點Oklo (OKLO) 於 November 12 與 Centrus Energy (LEU) 簽署最終協議，確保最多五座 Aurora 發電廠所需的核燃料，交付將於 2029 開始。Meta Platforms (META) 正在協助為 Oklo 計劃的 1 融資採購燃料。

news.title: Oklo Sits Near Its 52-Week Low After a 5-Reactor Fuel Deal. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysOklo signed definitive contracts with Centrus Energy for enough HALEU to run up to five Aurora powerhouses, with deliveries starting in 2029. Meta’s prepayment for future power supports the purchase, and Centrus now counts $5.
news.title_zh: Oklo 處於其 52 週低點附近，在 5 反應爐燃料交易後。是賣出還是加碼時機？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要 Oklo 與 Centrus Energy 簽署最終合約，取得足夠 HALEU 燃料最多運轉五座 Aurora 電廠，交貨自 2029 開始。Meta 為未來電力預付款支持採購，Centrus 現計有 $5。

news.summary: Key TakeawaysAMD shares jumped 6% after Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia’s CEO, and Broadcom rose with it. IonQ, SoundHound and Oklo fell instead, as investors cut back on the riskiest AI bets.

news.title: 3 Reasons Keep Me Buying SanDisk at $795
news.summary: SanDisk shares lost nearly 40% in a month while revenue nearly quadrupled. One investor sees a market pricing in a crash that contracts, cash flow, and buybacks suggest is not coming, and he keeps adding. What is he seeing that Wall Street is not?

news.title: SK hynix Just Hit a New 52-Week Low, Down 38% From Its September High. Still “Ridiculously Cheap”?
news.summary: Key TakeawaysSK hynix just hit a new 52-week low, down 38% from its September high, in an AI-hardware selloff that has also hit Micron and Sandisk. Most of the selling followed news from other companies, including the CEO’s resignation at Nvidia, SK hynix’s biggest customer, while SK hynix posted the best quarter in its history.
news.title_zh: SK hynix 剛創下 52 週新低，較九月高點下跌 38%。仍「極度便宜」？
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要SK hynix 剛創下 52 週新低，較九月高點下跌 38%，在一波也波及美光和 Sandisk 的 AI 硬體拋售潮中。大部分拋售緊隨其他公司消息而來，包括輝達執行長辭職（SK hynix 最大客戶），而 SK hynix 卻交出史上最佳單季表現。

news.title: Why Is Micron Down? GF Securities Warns a “NAND Glut” Could Hit in 2027
news.summary: Key TakeawaysMicron fell 3% today after GF Securities forecast NAND prices falling in three of 2027’s four quarters, and Sandisk fell with it. Sandisk is the most exposed, but analysts still expect its revenue to grow through June 2028, when GF expects prices to be falling.
news.title_zh: 為何美光下跌？GF Securities 警告「NAND 供過於求」可能在 2027 發生
news.summary_zh: 重點摘要美光今日下跌 3%，因 GF Securities 預測 NAND 價格在 2027 的四個季度中有三個季度下跌，Sandisk 也隨之下跌。Sandisk 風險最高，但分析師仍預期其營收將持續增長至 June 2028，屆時 GF 預期價格將下跌。

news.summary: Nvidia's CEO scandal keeps dragging on, weighing on AI chip sales forecasts, and damaging Sandisk stock.

news.title_zh: 為何 Sandisk 股價持續下跌
news.summary_zh: Nvidia 執行長醜聞持續發酵，拖累 AI 晶片銷售預測，並打擊 Sandisk 股價。

news.summary: Our Nov 16 piece, What Just Happened To SanDisk Stock?, looked at a 5.6% fall on Friday, Nov 13, that came with no company news. The selling did not stop there. Sandisk fell another 8.6% on Monday, Nov 16, closing at $809.11. The broad market had a bad day too, with the S&P 500 down 1.9%. The stock now sits 65.3% below its record close of $2,335.00 on June 25. That raises the longer question: where could Sandisk be in five years.

news.summary: Oracle closed Tuesday at $115, 65% below its September 2025 peak and a cent above the low of the slide, before Nvidia's beat lifted it about 2.1% pre-market. In 27 years of prices the stock has lost more than half its value only once before, in 2000, and that fall took nearly 17 years to undo.
